title: Welcome to the BMS Blog
author: Editorial Desk
summary: What this blog is for, how often it appears, and what you will find in it.
body:
This blog is a new corner of the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh website. Every Sunday morning it carries one article for karyakartas, workers, students of labour questions and anyone who wants to understand how India's largest national trade union centre thinks.

## What you will find here

- **Labour law in plain words:** the four Labour Codes, wages, social security, safety and industrial relations.
- **The world of work beyond India:** the International Labour Organization, the BRICS Trade Union Forum and BMS's international engagements.
- **People and ideas:** the life of founder Dattopant Thengadi, the philosophy behind *Rashtra hit, Udyog hit, Mazdoor hit*, and what leaders have said about the movement.
- **Those who are often left out:** unorganised workers, gig and platform workers, and the millions of Anganwadi, ASHA and mid-day meal workers.
- **Union stories:** how BMS federations in railways, defence, banks, construction, mines and other sectors go about their work.

## How we write

Posts are written from public sources: the BMS website, the Ministry of Labour and Employment, the ILO, and the press. Where a post describes a BMS position, it says that this is BMS's position. Facts, dates and figures are cited at the end of each post. If you spot an error, please tell the web team so that it can be corrected.

## A note on dates

The first hundred posts of this blog cover the period from December 2024 to November 2026. They were prepared together and are dated by Sunday, so that the archive reads as a continuous weekly record. From here on, a new post is published every Sunday at 7:00 am.

Read, share, and write to us.
